title: 小儿垂钓
author: 胡令能

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 小儿垂钓 — 胡令能
蓬头穉子学垂纶，侧坐莓苔草映身。
路人借问遥招手，怕得鱼惊不应人。
visualReview: 已逐张查看：蓬头孩童侧坐苔岸持钓竿，回头向远处路人举手而不张口，草木遮映身体；无大鱼噱头，静水与小动作贴合诗意，画下留白。
